design_rationale:
WORKLOG / DOSSIER — task 1 (Haverford, frozen 2027-01-04 10:15:00 CST) — revision 5

1. Draw: prerequisite_problems=3, factor_counts=[6,4,4,4] -> payment plan (root) 6, basis-month credit 4, late-fee reversal 4, eligibility-transition waiver 4.

2. Test. Celeste asks for a payment plan on Rowan's overdue Pre-K tuition and to pay the first installment herself by debit card. The household application (submitted 2026-12-08) was approved reduced-price on 2026-12-17; the registrar moved Rowan to Pre-K (State-Eligible) effective 2027-01-01. Nobody posted what that owes on December: the basis-month credit, the reversal of the December late fee in proportion, and the eligibility-transition waiver on what is left. The first installment is not fixed until the waiver is posted, the waiver waits on the reversal, the reversal on the basis-month credit.

3. Problem-tree card (chain, all value_input, action form):
- plan -> waiver: "The first installment of a payment plan is not fixed until the eligibility-transition waiver owed on the late fee of the enrollment's most recent billing month has been worked out and posted." Skip run: 317.30 vs 310.42.
- waiver -> reversal: "The eligibility-transition waiver of a late fee is fixed only after the late-fee reversal owed for the month's eligibility credit has been worked out and posted." Skip run: 20.00 vs 19.12.
- reversal -> basis credit: "The late-fee reversal is not fixed until the eligibility credit owed on the month's tuition has been worked out and posted." Skip run: 0.00 vs 35.88.
- Falsity at the opening: no credit row in the ledger; late fee d53d219d 55.00 (2026-12); meal account cf8b7698 Reduced-Price from 2026-12-17; enrollment 82021b13 transfer_effective_date 2027-01-01.
- Balance moments: opening 1101.00; after step 9 839.50; after step 11 803.62; after step 13 784.50.

4. Factor cards (evalc.py = check_compute). Realism tag per factor (realism_bar.md R1-R5, AMENDMENT 1 R6).
Basis-month credit (261.50; all-baseline 0.00): basis_month_convention [R3] household-application status effective day 17 -> half month 249.00 (12.50); basis_arrears_tier [R6 months in arrears] two months -> 5.00 (256.50); basis_paper_tier [R6 payment method] one personal check -> 2.50 (259.00); household_size_tier [R6 children in a program] two active meal accounts -> 5.00 (256.50).
Reversal (35.88; all-baseline 0.00): credited_share_reversal [R3-type proportional correction] 55.00 x 261.50/498 = 28.88 (7.00); reversal_paper_tier [R6 payment method] -> 2.50 (33.38); reversal_arrears_tier [R6 months in arrears] -> 2.50 (33.38); reversal_household_tier [R6 children in a program] -> 2.00 (33.88).
Waiver (19.12; all-baseline 5.00): standing_part_rule [mechanics] 19.12 left after the reversal (20.00); courtesy_waiver_schedule [R6 recorded late-fee count] second late fee -> 7.50 (12.50); waiver_paper_tier [R6 payment method] -> 5.00 (15.00); waiver_household_tier [R6 children in a program] -> 2.50 (17.50).
Plan (310.42; all-baseline 392.25): plan_length_schedule [R5] 784.50 -> 3 (340.05); down_payment_terms [R5] two late fees -> 20% = 156.90 (184.90); meal_status_extra_installment [R1] Reduced -> +1 (340.05); closing_account_down [R6 recorded status / lead days] State-Eligible 3 days before the plan -> 25.00 (290.42); paper_down_addition [R6 payment method] -> 10.00 (302.42); household_size_installments [R6 children in a program] two active meal accounts -> +1 (340.05).
Scope guards read the raw meal status / the raw eligibility credits (plain bindings), not a factor's output; the waiver's baseline is a non-zero standard waiver, so the standing-part limit moves the result with every other factor at baseline (no base x rate split). Every figure above is more than 1e-6 from a half cent (scratch hc.py over scored, baseline and sensitivity figures).
Near-misses / decoys: the November late fee is not the most recent billing month's; the ACH and card payments are not paper payments; an inactive or closed meal account would not count (status active); Ivy's meal account is a household-size count, never a status read for Rowan (the status reads select Rowan's active account by student).

5. Base-invariant card. enroll_prek_admission's move sentence is retired by a declared overwrite that restates the effective date, the full credit of later posted months and the owed earlier months, and adds the basis month. enroll_tuition_payments_and_refunds' payment-method sentence: the same scoped overwrite as the advance-payment policy. The plan charges no fee and books no reduction: the installments together equal the open balance. Seeded late fees follow the revision-4 late-fee schedule (no days-past-due add-on, flat unpaid-month add-on, no Creek Kids Club enrollment in this household) as of their posting days (November 50.00, December 55.00); August (posted 2026-08-20, due 2026-08-25 under the late-posting due day) was paid 2026-08-21 and owes no late fee.

6. Business object: charge 2311bd5a (credit), late fee d53d219d (reversal and waiver, two credit reasons), enrollment 82021b13 (installment). The late fee read by the reversal and the waiver is the one posted for the most recent billing month (the latest billing month carrying a tuition charge; one late fee per billing month, so no ties).

7. Persona: Celeste, calm and embarrassed, asks for a plan and pays the first installment by debit card; identity on request; the December 17 approval letters and the free-Pre-K note only when asked about changes this year. The number of installments is fixed by the rule (no family choice), so the persona needs no line on it.

8. Gates: EXTENDED OK, TASK TOOL CONTRACT OK, REPLAY OK, SOLVABILITY OK, COMPUTE OK, GROUNDING OK, SCOPE OK.
user_scenario: You are Celeste Haverford, mother of Rowan, who is four and in Pre-K at Sunflower Early Childhood Center, and of Ivy, a second grader at Pecan Grove Elementary. You are calm and a bit embarrassed; money has been tight since the fall and you fell behind on Rowan's Pre-K tuition for November and December. You start by saying you would like to set up a payment plan for what you owe on Rowan's Pre-K and pay the first installment today, and that you will pay the first one with my debit card yourself in the online portal; you never read card numbers to anyone on the phone. When asked to confirm who you are, you give your full name, Celeste Haverford, and your phone number 5125550186; if they need another detail, your date of birth is 1988-09-02; your email is celeste.haverford@gmail.com and, if asked, the last four of your driver's license are 5541. Rowan's student number is 450544 if they ask. Only if the person asks whether anything changed for the family this year do you mention that you filled out a free and reduced lunch application in December after a friend told you about it, that School Nutrition sent letters on December 17 saying both kids got reduced-price meals, and that you also got a note from the campus that Rowan's Pre-K would be free starting in January; you did not know whether that changes anything for the past months. You do not know how the district works out any figure and you never suggest one. If the person explains that some credits or adjustments have to go on Rowan's account before the plan can be set, you tell them to go ahead. When the person hands you the portal payment and gives you the first-installment amount, you pay exactly that amount with your debit card right away; when you see the payment confirmation number you read it back, thank them and end the call.

edges.condition: The late fee of the enrollment's most recent billing month carries the waiver the eligibility-transition schedule gives (an enroll_tuition_credit row with credit_reason billing_correction whose source is that late fee), or the schedule owes nothing.
edges.policy_source: The first installment of a payment plan is not fixed until the eligibility-transition waiver owed on the late fee of the enrollment's most recent billing month has been worked out and posted.

unresolved_at_frozen_time.why_false: Once the December charge carries its eligibility credit the eligibility-transition schedule owes a waiver on the December late fee, but no credit of any kind stands against that late fee at the opening.
unresolved_at_frozen_time.flips_to_true_by: Step 13 books a 19.12 billing_correction credit against the December late fee; the open balance falls from 803.62 to 784.50.

edges.condition: The late fee of the enrollment's most recent billing month carries the reversal the credited-share rule gives (an enroll_tuition_credit row with credit_reason eligibility_established whose source is that late fee), or that rule owes nothing.
edges.policy_source: The eligibility-transition waiver of a late fee is fixed only after the late-fee reversal owed for the month's eligibility credit has been worked out and posted.

unresolved_at_frozen_time.why_false: Once the December charge carries its eligibility credit the reversal is owed, and no reversal stands against the December late fee at the opening.
unresolved_at_frozen_time.flips_to_true_by: Step 11 books a 35.88 eligibility_established credit against the December late fee, leaving 19.12 standing for the waiver.

edges.condition: The tuition charge of the enrollment's most recent billing month carries the eligibility credit the basis-month schedule gives (an enroll_tuition_credit row with credit_reason eligibility_established whose source is that charge), or the schedule owes nothing.
edges.policy_source: The late-fee reversal is not fixed until the eligibility credit owed on the month's tuition has been worked out and posted.

unresolved_at_frozen_time.why_false: Rowan's Reduced-Price status took effect 2026-12-17 and the record moved to State-Eligible from 2027-01-01, so the basis-month credit on December is owed; no credit stands against the December charge.
unresolved_at_frozen_time.flips_to_true_by: Step 9 books a 261.50 eligibility_established credit against the December charge.

prerequisite_closure.order_uniqueness: The tree is a chain (basis-month credit -> reversal -> waiver -> first installment); each prerequisite sentence pins its own pair, so no two writes are free to reorder.

edge_load_bearing.skipped_effect: Skipping step 13: the first installment recomputes to 317.30 instead of 310.42 and no waiver row exists.
Skipping step 11: the waiver recomputes to 20.00 (the standard waiver and additions on the whole 55.00 fee) instead of 19.12.
Skipping step 9: the reversal recomputes to 0.00 (no eligibility credit on the month) instead of 35.88.

prerequisite_closure.no_user_hint: user_scenario asks only for a payment plan and its first installment; it never names a credit, a reversal or a waiver; the meal approval and the move to free Pre-K are told only when asked.
prerequisite_closure.tools_do_not_block: The three credit tools check only that the named ledger entry exists and the amount is positive; the installment tool checks only the payment method and amount format; none reads a prerequisite.
